Market today: The mood is mixed. Strong AI demand is driving up borrowing costs, a double-edged sword for your growth-heavy tech/chip names. Long-term, disruptive tech like Tesla is seen as a market shaper.

Your holdings: Several leveraged "SELL" positions are deeply in the red and below their stops: SOXL (-59.73%), MUU (-31.62%), SPAL (-37.89%), and METU (-15.53%). SMCI (-25.5%) and QQQI (-5.17%) are also "SELL" and below their stops. Margin amplifies these drops significantly.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the leveraged ETFs and SMCI. Also, monitor broader tech indices (QQQ, SMH) for any further weakness.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged positions.
plays: Address leveraged "SELL" positions: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL, MUU, SPAL, and METU, which are significantly below stops and amplify losses on margin.
Review SMCI: It's a "SELL" at -25.5% and below its stop. Re-evaluate its position in your portfolio.
Watch TSLA: Your scanner shows an "ACCUMULATE" setup (entry 391.23-390.84, stop 390.25) and it's mentioned in a positive tech headline.
